QUOTE: `.gitmodules` registers `extern/llama.cpp` (from ggml-org/llama.cpp). ... The other dependencies (spdlog, ryml, json, httplib, Catch2) use `FetchContent`, but llama.cpp does not.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states llama.cpp is a git submodule at extern/llama.cpp, registered in .gitmodules and not fetched via FetchContent.
